articles.title: Bandhan Bank employee from Valsad records video showing floodwater rising to his neck in Gujarat; district saw over 1,100 mm rain in 16 hours
articles.summary: Gujarat is grappling with a severe rain crisis, causing extensive flooding across the state. A powerful video from Valsad depicts a Bandhan Bank employee submerged in neck-deep floodwater outside his home, symbolizing the intensity of the situation. This viral footage highlights the urgent challenges posed by the relentless monsoon downpours and the need for immediate disaster relief efforts.

articles.title: Before a Cyber Force, Fix Cyber Governance
articles.summary: The debate surrounding the creation of a dedicated Cyber Force is gaining momentum, with increasing calls for its establishment. However, the article suggests this discussion has misplaced priorities, focusing prematurely on structural aspects rather than critical strategic and operational considerations. It highlights the need to address foundational issues before focusing on the 'uniforms' of a new cyber command, emphasizing a more considered approach to national cyber defence.

articles.title: The German navy can’t get enough P-8 patrol aircraft
articles.summary: The German Navy is purchasing eight P-8A Poseidon maritime patrol aircraft to significantly boost its submarine-hunting capabilities. Despite the initial order, Germany's head of naval air warfare expressed a desire for ten, indicating a potential future expansion of this vital defence asset. This procurement strengthens Germany's maritime security and modernises its naval air force.

articles.title: Indonesia must not lag in global AI supply chain: Nezar Patria
articles.summary: Indonesia's Deputy Minister of Communication and Digital Affairs, Nezar Patria, stressed the nation's imperative to integrate into the global Artificial Intelligence (AI) industry supply chain.
